svg.title: Using Observer 2.3.2
svg.desc:
Using Observer 2.3.2
Choose a module on the start screen. The five module buttons then form a row above the workspace. Click the active module again to collapse or expand its panel.
- Routers collects NAT snapshots from the Keenetic routers you specify. - Connections analyzes saved connection CSV files. Use this module to group endpoints, compare two periods and export CSV or Excel reports. - TCP prepares destinations from observations and lets you check TCP reachability from the computer running Observer. - Traffic collects traffic statistics by device. - Issues lists routers with incomplete collection. Retry opens Routers and repeats collection for the affected routers.
To work with an existing report, open Connections, select the CSV files and run the analysis. A new router collection is optional. For a Windows x64 installation, choose the setup executable from the [2.3.2 release](https://github.com/KingProjects12/Observer-Control-Center/releases/tag/v2.3.2). For portable use, launch Observer.ControlCenter.exe. Both downloads have a matching SHA-256 file.

g.text: Using Observer 2.3.2
Choose a module on the start screen. Its buttons move above the workspace.
Select the active module again to collapse or expand its panel.
Routers
Collect NAT snapshots from selected Keenetic routers.
Connections
Group endpoints, compare two periods and export
the results to CSV or Excel.
TCP
Check observed TCP destinations for reachability
from the computer running Observer.
Traffic
Collect traffic statistics for each device.
Issues
See which routers had incomplete runs. Retry opens
Routers and collects from those devices again.
Existing CSV
Connections → Select CSV → Analyze CSV
Windows x64
Choose the installer or the portable Observer.ControlCenter.exe.
The release provides a SHA-256 checksum for each download.
